question_part_answerable: partly: the file cannot measure risk per mile driven because it contains no vehicle-miles-traveled exposure; it can show what share of reported crashes involved at least one motorist killed.
metric: Annual share of police-reported NYC crashes with at least one motorist killed
denominator: All eligible police-reported NYC crashes in each crash year
population: Police-reported motor-vehicle crashes in NYC with a usable crash year in 2013–2025; count crashes with one or more recorded motorist deaths in the numerator
filters: Crash dates in 2013–2025 inclusive; exclude rows with missing crash year or missing/negative motorist-killed count
initial_data_check: Scoped checks in check_2.csv: 2,132,218 crashes have dates in 2013–2025; each year has rows spanning Jan 1 through Dec 31, including 2025. No missing crash dates, missing motorist-killed values, or negative motorist-killed values were found. Zero motorist deaths occur in most crash rows and are retained as nonfatal crashes in the denominator.
data_check_decisions: Keep the full eligible date range and all crashes, including crashes with zero motorist deaths in the denominator; exclude no rows. Missing-year rows cannot be assigned to the requested time trend, but the check found none. No changes to the initial plan.

final_plan.question_part_answerable: Partly. The file cannot measure risk per mile driven because it contains no vehicle-miles-traveled exposure. It can show the share of reported crashes with one or more recorded motorist deaths.
final_plan.metric: Annual share of police-reported NYC crashes with at least one motorist killed
final_plan.denominator: All eligible police-reported NYC crashes in each crash year
final_plan.population: All police-reported motor-vehicle crashes in NYC with a crash date in 2013–2025 and a nonnegative motorist-killed count; numerator counts crashes with one or more recorded motorist deaths
final_plan.filters: Crash dates in 2013–2025 inclusive; include zero counts as no motorist-fatality crash; no rows are dropped by the checks
final_plan.years: 2013–2025 inclusive; observed dates span Jan 1 to Dec 31 in every year
final_plan.limitations: The denominator is reported crashes, not miles driven, trips, or motorists; the measure is therefore not motorist risk per mile and can also vary with crash volume and reporting.
